people.name: Alush
people.line: A campsite during Israel's wilderness journey.

translations.web: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
translations.bsb: They set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
translations.kjv: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
